title: Pain relief in chronic pancreatitis with epidural buprenorphine injection.
abstract: BACKGROUND: The management of intractable pain in chronic pancreatitis is difficult. A novel method for its relief is described. METHODS: Twelve patients were given a mixture of buprenorphine (0.3 mg) and blood (10-15 mL) into the epidural space. RESULTS: All patients had pain relief lasting up to six months. CONCLUSION: Epidural buprenorphine injection is a simple, safe and effective method for pain relief in chronic pancreatitis.
